# Vero Labs

> Vero Labs is an AI studio in Bangalore, India, offering AI services and custom AI development to businesses in any industry. Run by two engineers, Alakh Agrawal and Vishal Srivastava. Vero Labs is an OpenAI Partner Network member.

Vero Labs is a separate company from other businesses with "Vero" in their name.

## Some things we have built

- A phone agent that calls and qualifies new leads, live
- A WhatsApp agent that handles routine purchase chats with traders
- Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart rank and ad tracking
- A data-labelling tool for training a vision AI

These are examples. We are not tied to one industry or one kind of system.

## How to start

- Every project gets a fixed price after a free 30-minute scope call.
- Email vishal@vero.co.in or alakh@vero.co.in.
